summary: A post-unlock human-readable priority review exposed a semantic field-mapping defect in the construct-complete Community lane: the canonical clean-X source uses owner_disposition/claim_lane/text_or_excerpt/published_at, while the construct builder classified legacy disposition/text/date fields. The lane object existed and structural QA passed, but physical/technique/rating subrows could be silently empty. No owner verdict was recorded. Owner review is re-locked until source-derived semantic multiset QA proves exact Community propagation and the construct queue is regenerated/rebound.
